follow-up time: From 12 months before a livebirth until 2 months after
exposure: Adolescents with diabetes complicated by ketoacidosis and/or end-organ damage
cohort: Females 12 to 19 years old who had a livebirth
finding: Compared with normal adolescent pregnancies, pregestational diabetes significantly increases risks of adverse pregnancy outcomes and significantly escalates healthcare utilization and cost.
mod_finding: Adolescents with uncomplicated diabetes had increased odds of cesarean delivery
